_note: Armour sets the GAME dyes a RANDOM colour on creation (not player-dyed, not OG/exotic). A piece from one of these sets showing an off-default colour is NOT a rare exotic — it just rolled a random colour. They are filed under the 'random_dyed' category at lowest priority so they never flood the feed. Matching is by item-id SUBSTRING (uppercased): 'SATIN' catches SATIN_TROUSERS, 'OXFORD' catches OXFORD_SHOES, etc. Edit freely — add a pattern to downrank a set, remove one to treat it normally.
